## Orientation

Territory: `dashboard/bin/dashboard-status --tmux`, `se-workflow.tmux` status-right segment with `@dashboard-status-right` on|off. Cover with `-m tmux` test. Do not edit `app.py` (gates-ui). Reuse the same landing-merge path so counts match.

Worktree: `/home/andrewyin/se-workflow--human-gates`
Do not edit `.artifacts/` or call `adaptive-artifacts`.

Follow `## Approach`.

### Requirements (R8)

R8: se-workflow.tmux appends status-right segment showing needs-you count (e.g. ⚑ 3), nothing when zero or no store; `@dashboard-status-right off` disables.

### Design Invariants

Same merge path as app for counts. Guard against duplicate status-right appends on reload.

### Decisions

needs-you-alerts (segment companion).
